notes.title: Patch 1.1.0
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

What a ride! We have reached 90% positive ratings here on STEAM. Thank you all for playing and all the kind words!

We have just released a patch to fix some issues.

Added

 LiveSplit support for speedrunners

Improved

 "Grabbability" of collectible in act 4 [spoiler]flask in Desk[/spoiler]
 FOV for static cameras considers aspect ratio -> support for 32:9 screens
 Martha studio crouch hint shown only once.

Fixed

 Train: After decoupling mouse couldn't be moved anymore
 Forest: Someone ran crazy in circles off the map
 Studio: Achievement "Flawless" triggered even if not played flawlessly.
 Boiler room: Some sound issues
 Save slot percentage in main menu didn't update properly after finishing the game
 Speech in apartment didn't play again
 Horse race machine in Dories room could break and stop progress
 Forest: Door to "nothing" could be opened in Dories room
 Forest: Round items had strange reflections
 Funhouse: Player could fall off map when walking back.


If you have any feedback or just want to talk about REVEIL, feel free to join our Discord!

- Your Team Pixelsplit

notes.title: Release Date & Pre-Order Announcement!
notes.notes:

REVEIL will launch on STEAM March 6th 2024!

Take a trip into Walter Thompson's shattered psyche and immerse yourself in a wonderfully dark, twisted world where nothing is as it seems.
Become part of an incredible story in which you are confronted with challenging puzzles, contradictory clues and beautifully surreal environments.
